description: Implantations des antennes relais sur la ville du Haillan is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Identification des implantations des antennes relais des différents opérateurs sur la commune du Haillan. Données produites par la Ville du Haillan sur la base de la carte des antennes relais nationales. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The publisher named on the listing is Bordeaux Métropole. Its keywords include data-gouv, antennes-relais, infrastructure-physique-reseau. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2023-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
